# Keep every optional field when a draft is recovered from the keyboard

## What & Why
Keyboard recovery now proves the core answer and opportunity values return before expiry, but the remaining selectable fields are not covered by that activation path. A regression could silently reset an answer category or an opportunity status and priority.

## Done looks like
- Recovering an answer with the keyboard preserves its selected category.
- Recovering an opportunity with the keyboard preserves its status and priority.
- The assertions live alongside the existing keyboard recovery coverage.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
